tempelriddarens_ed.name: Templar's Oath
tempelriddarens_ed.lore: When the sky split, the last templars swore to keep the graves shut. They held the oath for seven nights. On the eighth, the graves opened from within.

edens_klinga.name: Oathblade
edens_klinga.lore: The blade bears the names of every knight who fell at the graves. There is room left for one more.

edens_mur.name: Oathwall
edens_mur.lore: Once it bore the white cross of the order. Now only claw marks and soot remain where the cross stood.

edens_visir.name: Oath Visor
edens_visir.lore: Through this visor the knights watched their brothers rise from the earth. Stare too long, they say, and you will see them still.

edens_pansar.name: Oathplate
edens_pansar.lore: The plate is dented from the inside, as if something tried to get out. No knight will say why.

edens_steg.name: Oathstride
edens_steg.lore: These boots leave a trail of cold ash. The templars learned to walk quietly past the dead.

bergsklanens_raseri.name: Fury of the Mountain Clan
bergsklanens_raseri.lore: The Mountain Clan devoured their dead rather than leave them to the demons. Their fury lives on in what they wore, hungry and proud.

klanhovdingens_yxa.name: Clanchief's Axe
klanhovdingens_yxa.lore: With this axe the chieftain cut down his own twisted son. Then he kept cutting, until no demon stood on the mountain.

forfadernas_skalle.name: Skull of the Forefathers
forfadernas_skalle.lore: A helm made from an ancestor's skull, so the dead might see the battle with their own eyes. Sometimes it laughs.

vargpalsen.name: The Wolfpelt
vargpalsen.lore: Taken from the first wolf twisted in the mountains. It still keeps you warm, but it smells of iron.

blodnavarna.name: Bloodfists
blodnavarna.lore: The clan's warriors never washed their gloves. Every stain is a name they refuse to forget.

trofebaltet.name: Trophy Belt
trofebaltet.lore: Teeth, horns and claws of demons slain by the clan. There are no empty hooks left.

jaktgudinnans_dottrar.name: Daughters of the Huntress
jaktgudinnans_dottrar.lore: When all others fled, the amazons stayed and hunted in the ruins. No one knows what they hunted in the end. Only that none came home.

dottrarnas_spjut.name: Spear of the Daughters
dottrarnas_spjut.lore: Passed from mother to daughter for eleven generations. The last daughter left it in Wolfstead, wedged in a bear's heart.

manbagen.name: Moonbow
manbagen.lore: The bow sings softly in moonlight. The amazons said it sang louder on nights when someone would die.

jagarinnans_hatta.name: Huntress's Hood
jagarinnans_hatta.lore: The hood hid the huntresses from twisted eyes. Against demons, it did nothing at all.

skugglader.name: Shadowhide
skugglader.lore: Tanned in the bog water of Mistshore, blacker than night. It never creaks.

tysta_steg.name: Silent Steps
tysta_steg.lore: These sandals taught the huntresses to walk without a sound over bone and glass. Their last tracks lead down into the mines of Copperfell.

gravvaktarens_arv.name: Gravewarden's Legacy
gravvaktarens_arv.lore: Before the dead rose, there were those who guarded them. Their gear is all that still remembers how to keep the dead down.

vaktarens_hammare.name: Warden's Hammer
vaktarens_hammare.lore: The Gravewardens shattered any bone that moved. It has struck so often the haft has worn to the shape of a hand.

vaktarens_lock.name: Warden's Lid
vaktarens_lock.lore: This shield was once a coffin lid. The wardens thought the dead should be met with their own wood.

vaktarens_brynja.name: Warden's Mail
vaktarens_brynja.lore: Covered in tiny runes, one carved for every night of watch. The carving stopped after ninety nights.

vaktarens_grepp.name: Warden's Grip
vaktarens_grepp.lore: These gloves carried hundreds of coffins to the earth. Now they feel cold, as if waiting for the next.

vaktarens_ben.name: Warden's Bone
vaktarens_ben.lore: A finger bone of the first Gravewarden. He asked to keep watch even after death.

askvandrarens_borda.name: Ashwalker's Burden
askvandrarens_borda.lore: A pilgrim walked into Ashenhold to pray for the city. What he carried was found strewn along the Ash Road. Him, no one found.

pilgrimens_torn.name: Pilgrim's Thorn
pilgrimens_torn.lore: The pilgrim used this dagger to carve his prayers into trees along the road. At the gates of Ashenhold, the lines end mid-word.

den_svartade_rustningen.name: The Blackened Armor
den_svartade_rustningen.lore: It was white when the pilgrim entered Ashenhold. It came out black, and empty.

botgordeln.name: Penitent's Girdle
botgordeln.lore: The pilgrim cinched it tighter for every sin he remembered. It is still too tight.

askvagen.name: The Ash Road
askvagen.lore: These boots walked all the way to Ashenhold and back. No one wore them on the way home.

den_branda_runan.name: The Burnt Rune
den_branda_runan.lore: Branded into the amulet by the Ash Prince's own fire. It whispers of a power not yet yours.

benviskarens_drakt.name: Bonewhisperer's Garb
benviskarens_drakt.lore: After the wolves took Wolfstead, a hermit lived among the bones. He learned to hear the dead whisper through them. In the end, he whispered back.

viskarens_skalle.name: Whisperer's Skull
viskarens_skalle.lore: The skull of the hermit's own brother. He wore it so he would never stop hearing his voice.

viskarens_revben.name: Whisperer's Ribs
viskarens_revben.lore: Each rib belonged to a villager the wolves left behind. At night they knock against each other, as if asking to be let in.

viskarens_fingrar.name: Whisperer's Fingers
viskarens_fingrar.lore: The finger bones move on their own, pointing at what is about to die. Most often they point at the wearer.

viskarens_kotor.name: Whisperer's Spine
viskarens_kotor.lore: Strung from the vertebrae of a child who was never found. The hermit said it was the only way to keep it close.

viskarens_steg.name: Whisperer's Steps
viskarens_steg.lore: These boots leave no tracks, only a faint crunch, like bone on bone. Wolves never follow the one who wears them.

runsmidd_klinga.name: Runeforged Blade
runsmidd_klinga.lore: Forged by the village smith with runes he did not understand, the night the runestones went dark. He died before he could ask what they meant.

gravvaktarens_hillebard.name: Gravewarden's Halberd
gravvaktarens_hillebard.lore: With this halberd the Gravewarden held the village gate for three days. When morning came he was still standing. He was no longer breathing.

benkungens_lie.name: The Bone King's Scythe
benkungens_lie.lore: Valdemar was a chieftain before he was king of bones. With this scythe he reaped his own village.

runskold.name: Runeshield
runskold.lore: It bears the same runes as the stones in the forest. When they wake, it glows faintly, like the memory of something lost.

gravvaktarens_pansar.name: Gravewarden's Plate
gravvaktarens_pansar.lore: This plate has never left the village. Its wearer sometimes feels hands tugging at it from beneath the earth.

benkungens_krona.name: Crown of the Bone King
benkungens_krona.lore: The crown bound the Old Village to death. Its wearer still hears Valdemar's voice, counting his subjects.

vargblodets_band.name: Wolfblood Band
vargblodets_band.lore: Found in the belly of Ulvhild the Greybear, still around a finger. Its wearer dreams of running with the pack.

flyktingens_sandaler.name: The Runaway's Sandals
flyktingens_sandaler.lore: A child fled through Wildwood in these sandals when the demons came. The sandals reached Wolfstead. The child did not.

vargtandens_kniv.name: Wolftooth Knife
vargtandens_kniv.lore: The hunters of Wolfstead made knives from the teeth of the wolves that turned on them. This tooth came from the packleader's own hound.

korpmoderns_bage.name: The Raven Mother's Bow
korpmoderns_bage.lore: The Raven Mother guarded Mistshore with her bow and her birds, until the mist took them all. The ravens still wait on the rooftops for her.

dimvandrarens_handskar.name: Mistwalker's Gloves
dimvandrarens_handskar.lore: The drowned of Mistshore seek hands to hold. Whoever wears these gloves is never alone in the mist.

klockarens_hammare.name: The Bellringer's Hammer
klockarens_hammare.lore: When the spiders came, the bellringer of Copperfell melted down the church bell. He no longer rang for mass. He rang to kill.

jarnmunkens_gordel.name: The Iron Monk's Girdle
jarnmunkens_gordel.lore: The monk of the mine cloister locked himself in this girdle so he would not be twisted. The lock held. The monk did not.

valkyrians_sista_andetag.name: Valkyrie's Last Breath
valkyrians_sista_andetag.lore: The valkyrie fell into the Broodmother's web and fought until she could not breathe. The feather on the spear still flutters, as if she is trying again.

pilgrimens_sista_svard.name: The Pilgrim's Last Sword
pilgrimens_sista_svard.lore: It was the pilgrim's sword before it became his gravestone. Someone pulled it from the ash, and the runes have begun to burn again.

tystnadens_stilett.name: Stiletto of Silence
tystnadens_stilett.lore: The assassins of Ashenhold used it to silence priests before the city fell. The demons liked it, and left it where it lay.

hornslaktarens_bila.name: Hornbutcher's Cleaver
hornslaktarens_bila.lore: Hornbutchers swing this cleaver until nothing moves. Every notch in the iron is a man it has butchered.

sista_vaktens_mur.name: The Last Sentinel's Wall
sista_vaktens_mur.lore: The last sentinel of Ashenhold held the gate with this shield while the city burned behind him. Scratches from a thousand claws cover the city's crest.

askfurstens_horn.name: Horns of the Ash Prince
askfurstens_horn.lore: Morvath's horns broke off when he crushed the last church in Ashenhold. The helm was forged around them, and their embers have never died.

smittfaderns_kapa.name: The Blightfather's Shroud
smittfaderns_kapa.lore: The Blightfather wore this shroud as he preached the Change. Something beneath it still lives.

likatarens_kake.name: The Carrion Jaw
likatarens_kake.lore: The oldest carrion wolf in the Old Village fed on the Bone King's dead for a hundred years. When it died the jaw remained, and it still bit.

revbensburen.name: The Ribcage
revbensburen.lore: The Bog Queen kept her lovers in a cage of their own ribs. Its wearer still hears them begging to be let out.

miras_docka.name: Mira's Doll
miras_docka.lore: When her brother did not return, Mira sewed a lock of his hair into this doll. She gave it to the one who brought his sandals home.

ristarens_mejsel.name: The Runecarver's Chisel
ristarens_mejsel.lore: With this chisel the forest runes were carved. It lay in the crypt as if the carver had set it down, meaning to come back.

hovdingens_signet.name: The Chieftain's Signet
hovdingens_signet.lore: Valdemar wore this signet before the crown took him. Given by the living, it carries the village's thanks, not its curse.
